title:
Argon2 is modern ASIC-resistant, GPU-resistant, memory-hard hashing algorithm.
 It has better password cracking resistance than PBKDF2, Bcrypt and Scrypt
 and is the winner of the Password Hashing Competition in 2015.
 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argon2
 Argon2 RFC: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9106/
